plan.notes: Official University of Louisville 2026-2027 catalog, Computer Science (BA) Flight Plan (minimum 121 total hours). 12 hours of CSE electives are chosen from the approved elective list (CSE 504, 516, 522, 528, 530, 532, 538, 545, 546, 547, 551, 555, 564, 565, 566, 568, 570, 590, 593, or department-approved 5XX/6XX courses), or a declared track (Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Cybersecurity) may satisfy them. Blank cells in the official Flight Plan are recorded as unspecified general-education/Other-Areas-of-Study (OAS) electives. CSE 298 is a 0-credit required seminar (recorded with required_zero).
